definitions.def: Verified gross mass of a packed container (cargo + packing + dunnage + tare). Required under SOLAS VI/2 as amended.
Weigh the packed sealed container using calibrated equipment.
Weigh all packages/items/securing material + add container tare using a method certified by the competent authority of the packing State.
Party named on BL/sea waybill (or who concluded the contract of carriage) — responsible for providing VGM (MSC.1/Circ.1475).
Availability of VGM to master and terminal sufficiently in advance for stowage plan is a condition for loading (not an entitlement to load).

who_pays.typical: Shipper obtains/pays for weighing; if terminal weighs on behalf of shipper, commercial parties apportion cost (Circ.1475 §13 contingencies).

who_responsible: Shipper: obtain & document VGM, submit in time.
Master & terminal: must have VGM before loading under SOLAS.
National competent authority: Method 2 certification framework.
common_pitfalls: Confusing SI cargo weight with VGM — they can differ; large gaps trigger carrier WDF (commercial).
Late VGM → rolled cargo / missed cutoff.
Inventing national tolerances (e.g. folklore ±1000 kg) without statute URL.
Assuming terminal reweigh always replaces shipper duty — contingencies are commercial.

faq.a: SOLAS 下责任在 shipper（提单/运输合同托运人）。货代可代办，但法律责任框架仍指向 shipper 定义（Circ.1475）。

faq.q: 没有 VGM 能装船吗？
faq.a: 原则上不能。指南允许船长与码头代表代为取得 VGM（如码头称重），费用分摊由商业约定——不是免费豁免。
Method 1 整柜称重；Method 2 分项累加+皮重，且方法须经装箱完成国主管机关认可。选法看设施与国别规则。

faq.q: 近 7 天 X 几乎没人聊 VGM，还重要吗？
faq.a: 重要。热度低说明是「默会规则」而非热点八卦；装船阻断不依赖社媒刷屏。
